def VTask.replaceVertex {V : Type u_1} (G : SimpleGraph V) (s t : V) [DecidableEq V] : SimpleGraph V where
  Adj u v := 
    if u = t then
      v ≠ t ∧ G.Adj s v
    else if v = t then
      u ≠ t ∧ G.Adj s u
    else
      G.Adj u v
  sym := by

    split
    intro h
    cases (decidable.eq_dec u t) with {mp := hut}

        cases h
      case neg hvt =>
        have h1 : v ≠ t := h.left
        have h2 : G.Adj s v := h.right
        exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
    case neg hut =>
      cases (decidable.eq_dec v t) with {mp := hvt}
      case pos hvt =>
        have h1 : u ≠ t := h.left
        have h2 : G.Adj s u := h.right
        exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
      case neg hvt =>
        exact G.sym u v h

    case neg hvt =>
